title: Executive Director, Process Lead, Corporate Functions Operations, Enterprise Business Services
text:
**The Estée Lauder Companies Inc.** is one of the world’s leading manufacturers, marketers, and sellers of quality skin care, makeup, fragrance, and hair care products, and is a steward of luxury and prestige brands globally. The company’s products are sold in approximately 150 countries and territories under brand names including: Estée Lauder, Aramis, Clinique, Lab Series, Origins, M·A·C, La Mer, Bobbi Brown Cosmetics, Aveda, Jo Malone London, Bumble and bumble, Darphin Paris, TOM FORD, Smashbox, AERIN Beauty, Le Labo, Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle, GLAMGLOW, KILIAN PARIS, Too Faced, Dr.Jart+, the DECIEM family of brands, including The Ordinary and NIOD, and BALMAIN Beauty.

**Description**
---------------

**Key Responsibilities**

**Corporate Process Ownership & Governance**

* Lead governance for assigned corporate process domains
* Define standards, accountabilities, controls, decision rights, and escalation paths
* Partner with Global Process Owners and functional leaders to establish priorities and transformation roadmaps
* Align policies, controls, service requirements, and technology enablement across functions
* Facilitate governance forums and resolve cross-functional issues involving EBS teams and third-party providers

**End-to-End Process Design & Optimization**

* Simplify, standardize, and integrate cross-functional processes across organizational boundaries
* Apply Lean, Six Sigma, process mining, and related methodologies to identify improvement opportunities
* Design processes that enhance efficiency, controls, service quality, resilience, and user experience
* Define global standards while evaluating and approving necessary local variations

**Risk, Controls, and Compliance**

* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Privacy, Security, Audit, and Records Management leaders to incorporate requirements into process design
* Ensure process changes maintain effective controls and compliance standards
* Address process and control gaps through improvements in workflow, governance, tech, data, and accountability
* Support remediation of audit and operational findings

**Service Delivery & Experience**

* Improve employee and stakeholder experience through streamlined workflows, clear service models, and effective knowledge management
* Define service expectations and responsibilities across retained functions, EBS teams, and external providers
* Leverage stakeholder feedback and operational data to identify and address service gaps
* Promote self-service capabilities and user-friendly process design

**Performance & Value Realization**

* Develop and maintain a prioritized process improvement roadmap
* Define and track outcomes related to cost, productivity, service quality, control effectiveness, and risk reduction
* Establish performance measures, governance routines, and escalation mechanisms
* Support business case development and benefit realization tracking

**Digital Enablement**

* Partner with Tech and Data teams to incorporate automation, analytics, workflow solutions, and AI-enabled capabilities
* Identify opportunities to eliminate manual work and improve data quality and transparency
* Ensure digital solutions align with business and stakeholder needs
* Promote integrated platforms and processes across corporate functions

**Transformation & Op Model Support**

* Provide process leadership for migrations, consolidations, outsourcing initiatives, and operating model changes
* Define future-state processes and support implementation, adoption, and stabilization
* Assess process, control, data, and organizational risks associated with transformation initiatives
* Ensure transitioned processes have appropriate ownership, controls, measures, and governance

**Stakeholder & Capability Leadership**

* Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across corporate functions and EBS
* Present recommendations, trade-offs, and investment priorities in business terms
* Influence outcomes across a global matrixed organization
* Coach process leaders on governance and continuous improvement practices

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required Qualifications and Competencies**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business or a relevant area of study
* 12+ years of experience in corporate functions, enterprise operations, GBS/shared services, process excellence, or large-scale transformation
* Strong understanding of corporate-function operating models, service delivery, internal controls, governance, and cross-functional dependencies
* Experience operating in a global, matrixed organization and influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority.
* Demonstrated success standardizing and improving complex processes across functions, geographies, delivery centers, and third-party providers
* Experience operating in a global, matrixed organization and influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority
* Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, value-stream mapping, process mining, or comparable process-improvement methodologies. Relevant certification is preferred
* Strong financial and operational judgment, analytical problem-solving, executive communication, and change leadership
* Experience with shared services, outsourcing, multi-vendor delivery, service management, and global process governance is preferred
* Ability to incorporate risk, control, privacy, security, and regulatory requirements into practical and effective process designs

**Pay Range:**

The anticipated base salary range for this position is **$158,650.00** to **$272,700.00**. Exact salary depends on several factors such as experience, skills, education, and budget. Salary range may vary based on geographic location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in a highly competitive bonus program as well as participation in the share incentive plan. In addition,

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in a highly competitive bonus program with the possibility for overachievement based on performance and company results. In addition, The Estée Lauder Companies offers a variety of benefits to eligible employees, including health insurance coverage (medical, dental, and vision insurance), wellness and family support programs, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, paid leave programs, education-related programs, paid holidays and vacation time, and many others. Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by the company.
